question: How should the practitioner sequence worship from the right foot to the head and then from the left head onward?
premises: Worship proceeds from right foot to head.
Then the left side proceeds from head onward.
inference: The rite prescribes a bodily circuit of worship.
uncertainties: Exact body parts and ritual direction beyond the compound hints are not explicit.
plain_english: Worship from the right foot up to the head, and likewise from the left head onward.
